description: The line-neutral policy core: submissions and quotes, the policy contract, its terms and transactions, the parties and producers on it, the risks it insures, the coverages and their terms, attached forms, rating modifiers and the written-premium ledger.

values.GROUP_MASTER: Group master contract issued to an employer, association or trust
values.CERTIFICATE: Certificate or member-level contract under a group master

values.PENDING: Bound or applied for, not yet in force
values.LAPSED: Terminated for non-payment after grace period (life/health)
values.DEATH_CLAIM: Terminated by death of the insured
values.CONVERTED: Converted or exchanged to another policy

policy_transaction_type.description: Kind of change applied to a policy.

values.ANNIVERSARY: Scheduled anniversary processing on continuous contracts

policy_transaction_status.description: Processing status of a policy transaction.

policy_party_role.description: Role a party plays on a policy.

values.GROUP_SPONSOR: Employer or association sponsoring a group contract

policy_producer_role.description: Role of a producer on a policy.

insurable_object_type.description: Kind of thing or exposure that can be insured.

values.BUSINESS_OPERATION: Business operations at a location (liability, workers' comp, cyber, professional)
values.SCHEDULED_ITEM: Scheduled personal or business property, equipment, cargo

coverage_trigger.description: What must happen in the policy period for coverage to respond.

premium_charge_type.description: Kind of amount charged on a policy.

values.STATE_SURCHARGE: Statutory assessment or surcharge (e.g. FIGA, FHCF, WC assessments)

entities.name: submission
entities.description: A request for insurance received from an applicant or producer, prior to and independent of any policy.

attributes.name: is_renewal
attributes.description: True for renewal re-underwriting of an existing policy.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: AGENT_PORTAL, DIRECT_WEB, CALL_CENTER, API, EXCHANGE, PAPER, ...

attributes.name: application_data
attributes.description: Application answers not modeled as attributes (underwriting questionnaires).

entities.name: quote
entities.description: A priced offer made in response to a submission. A submission may have several quote versions or options; at most one is bound into a policy transaction.

attributes.name: quote_data
attributes.description: Full rated quote payload (risks, coverages, rating worksheet) as produced by the quoting system.

entities.name: policy
entities.description: An insurance contract between an insurer and a policyholder, identified by a policy number that persists across renewals. For group business the master contract and each certificate are policies linked by master_policy_id.

attributes.name: insurer_id
attributes.description: Writing company.

attributes.name: master_policy_id
attributes.description: Group master contract for a certificate.

attributes.name: governing_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: State whose law and filings govern the contract (issue state).

attributes.name: original_inception_date
attributes.description: First effective date of continuous coverage; issue date for life and annuity.

attributes.name: replaces_policy_id
attributes.description: Prior policy this one rewrote, converted from or replaced (including 1035 exchanges).

attributes.name: is_assumed_business
attributes.description: True for policies acquired through assumption or book transfer.

entities.name: policy_term
entities.description: A contiguous period of coverage under a policy, typically 6 or 12 months for P&C and plan-year for health. Continuous contracts (life, annuity) have a single open-ended term.

attributes.name: term_number
attributes.description: 1 for the first term, incremented at each renewal.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Null for continuous contracts.

attributes.name: product_filing_id
attributes.description: Rate filing edition the term is rated under.

attributes.name: is_auditable
attributes.description: True when premium is subject to audit of actual exposure.

entities.name: policy_transaction
entities.description: A dated change to a policy: new business, endorsement, renewal, cancellation, reinstatement, audit and so on. The unit of policy versioning and the source of all written premium.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Order of processing within the term.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Business date the change takes effect.

attributes.name: processed_at
attributes.description: When the change was recorded (transaction time).

attributes.name: accounting_date
attributes.description: Date the transaction is booked for financial reporting.

attributes.name: is_out_of_sequence
attributes.description: True when effective earlier than a previously processed transaction in the term.

entities.name: policy_party
entities.description: A party's role on a policy, optionally scoped to one risk (e.g. lienholder on a vehicle, mortgagee on a building).

attributes.name: interest_rank
attributes.description: Priority among interests of the same role (1st mortgagee, 2nd mortgagee).

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Loan number or similar reference of the interested party.

entities.name: policy_producer
entities.description: A producer credited with a policy, with their share of commission.

entities.name: insurable_object
entities.description: A real-world thing, person or activity exposed to loss, independent of any policy. Supertype for line-specific objects (vehicle, structure, watercraft, scheduled item, business operation). The same object can be insured on successive or multiple policies.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: The person (object type PERSON) or organization (BUSINESS_OPERATION) that is the subject of insurance.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Fixed location of the object, if it has one.

attributes.name: additional_attributes
attributes.description: Characteristics of specialty objects with no dedicated subtype entity.

entities.name: policy_location
entities.description: A premises or location scheduled on a policy.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Rating territory.

entities.name: policy_risk
entities.description: An insurable object as insured under a policy (a risk unit): the vehicle on an auto policy, the building at a location, the insured life, the operations of a business in a state. Supertype for line-specific rating detail.

attributes.name: risk_number
attributes.description: Stable number of the risk on the policy (vehicle 1, building 2); unchanged across versions.

attributes.name: rating_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: State the risk is rated and reported in; may differ from the governing state on multi-state policies.

attributes.name: insured_value_amount
attributes.description: Total insured value or stated amount, where applicable.

attributes.name: additional_attributes
attributes.description: Policy-specific rating characteristics with no dedicated subtype entity.

entities.name: policy_coverage
entities.description: A coverage, benefit or rider in force on a policy, either at policy level or for one risk.

attributes.name: policy_risk_id
attributes.description: Null for policy-level coverages.

attributes.name: retroactive_date
attributes.description: Claims-made retroactive date.

attributes.name: extended_reporting_end_date
attributes.description: End of tail coverage, if purchased.

attributes.name: asl_code
attributes.description: Overrides the coverage definition's statutory line.

attributes.name: annualized_premium_amount
attributes.description: Full-term premium for this version of the coverage as rated.

entities.name: policy_coverage_term
entities.description: The selected value of a limit, deductible or other term for a coverage on a policy.

attributes.name: term_value
attributes.description: Numeric value: amount, percent, days, months or count per the definition's value type.

attributes.name: term_code_value
attributes.description: Selected option when the term is a coded choice.

entities.name: policy_form
entities.description: A form or endorsement attached to a policy.

attributes.name: variable_data
attributes.description: Fill-in values for manuscript or schedule fields on the form.

entities.name: policy_rating_modifier
entities.description: A discount, surcharge, experience modification, schedule credit or underwriting class applied in rating a policy, risk or coverage.

attributes.name: factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative factor, e.g. 0.85 experience mod.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Flat amount when the modifier is additive.

entities.name: premium_transaction
entities.description: The written-premium ledger: one signed amount per policy transaction, coverage, state and charge type, with the coverage period it is earned over. Written, earned, unearned and in-force premium are all derived from these rows.

attributes.name: policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Null for policy-level fees and taxes.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed change in written amount; negative for return premium.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: State the premium is allocated to for statutory reporting and premium tax.

entities.name: underwriting_decision
entities.description: A recorded underwriting decision on a submission or policy transaction.

attributes.name: is_automated
attributes.description: True when decided by rules or a model without human review.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Reason given, including adverse action reasons.

entities.name: prior_coverage
entities.description: Insurance an applicant held previously with any carrier, as declared or verified at underwriting.

entities.name: underlying_policy
entities.description: A primary policy scheduled beneath an umbrella or excess policy, whether written by this insurer or another.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: The umbrella or excess policy.

attributes.name: internal_policy_id
attributes.description: The underlying policy when written by this insurer.
